title: Advancing extreme-temperature-tolerant zinc–air batteries through photothermal transition metal sulfide heterostructures
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,991-1001
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03240C, Paper
Yuqing Zhong, Yunzheng Zhang, Jiajian Wang, Huile Jin, Shuang Pan, Shun Wang, Yihuang Chen
Utilizing the photothermal assistance principle provides fascinating opportunities to explore the connection between the catalyst photothermal effect and zinc–air battery characteristics under normal to extreme conditions.
